valueExpression.name: pathway
valueExpression.expression: iif(%anaemia.empty() or %ironDeficiency.empty(), {}, iif(%anaemia, iif(%ferritin < 100, 'ida', iif(%ironDeficiency, iif(%inflammation, 'acd', 'ida'), 'anaemia')), iif(%ironDeficiency, 'id', 'none')))

name: PreoperativeAnaemiaManagement
title: PAM form assembled with the A5 + A6 solution modules (test)
publisher: FHIR in Queensland Health Connectathon — Track 1 (synthetic demo, not for clinical use)
description: Starter form for track 1: a few working items per module, with scaffolding for the rest.

item.text: To be built at the connectathon — scenario A1: the rest of Patient details. Indigenous status, interpreter required, preferred language, address and contacts — from the Patient; Write height and weight back as Observations when they are measured in clinic; Next of kin / emergency contact (RelatedPerson)

extension.valueString:
🚧 To be built at the connectathon — scenario A1: the rest of Patient details

  • Indigenous status, interpreter required, preferred language, address and contacts — from the Patient
  • Write height and weight back as Observations when they are measured in clinic
  • Next of kin / emergency contact (RelatedPerson)

item.text: To be built at the connectathon — scenario A2: GP details. Pre-populate the GP from Patient.generalPractitioner (Practitioner / PractitionerRole); Choose the source: referring doctor, GP from the latest admission, or manual entry (enableWhen); Write back an updated Patient.generalPractitioner

extension.valueString:
🚧 To be built at the connectathon — scenario A2: GP details

  • Pre-populate the GP from Patient.generalPractitioner (Practitioner / PractitionerRole)
  • Choose the source: referring doctor, GP from the latest admission, or manual entry (enableWhen)
  • Write back an updated Patient.generalPractitioner

item.text: To be built at the connectathon — scenario A3: Proposed surgery and referral. Pre-populate procedure, surgeon, unit, category and booked date from the waitlist ServiceRequest; Calculate days until surgery; Write back the referral to the blood management service (ServiceRequest)

extension.valueString:

item.text: To be built at the connectathon — scenario A4: Past medical and surgical history. Pre-populate Conditions, Procedures, medications and allergies; SNOMED CT-AU value sets bound with ECL on Ontoserver; enableWhen trees for follow-up questions (e.g. GI symptoms → gastroscopy / colonoscopy)

extension.valueString:
🚧 To be built at the connectathon — scenario A4: Past medical and surgical history

  • Pre-populate Conditions, Procedures, medications and allergies
  • SNOMED CT-AU value sets bound with ECL on Ontoserver
  • enableWhen trees for follow-up questions (e.g. GI symptoms → gastroscopy / colonoscopy)

item.text: Initial = latest result on or before the most recent IV iron order; post-treatment = latest result after it. With no IV iron order: initial = earliest result, post-treatment = latest.
